hero.title: Costume Museum
hero.subtitle: São Brás de Alportel
hero.description: Preserving the rich textile heritage of the Algarve region since 1988. Discover over 300 years of Portuguese fashion history.

about.title: Our History
about.description: The Costume Museum in São Brás de Alportel preserves and displays the rich textile heritage of the Algarve region. Founded in 1988, our museum houses one of Portugal's most comprehensive collections of traditional Portuguese costumes, folk clothing, and ceremonial dress.
about.missionText: To preserve, study, and promote Portuguese textile heritage through innovative exhibitions, educational programs, and cultural initiatives.

exhibitions.permanentDesc: Explore our core collection showcasing traditional cork and horse drawn carriages from various regions and time periods.

tours.description: Our guided tours offer an in-depth exploration of Portuguese textile traditions. Tours are available for groups of 10 or more people.
